title: The Mystery of the Distracting Demo
subtitle: 3 suspects, 3 weapons, 3 locations
storyHtml:
Byte never forgot his first few cases, but that was only because he never forgot any of his cases. However, this Dynavics mystery was particularly memorable.

Each suspect brought one item to one location, but on that day, only one was responsible for sabotaging the demonstration.

Go through the clues one at a time, placing the information provided onto the Deduction Grid.

clues.text: An anonymous Teams message read: RETNIRP LEBAL A DAH RACSO.
The Barcode Scanner was certainly not inside the Portal Room.
Jose’s fingerprint was found in the Forge Lab.
Rob was not inside the Dynavics Office.
The Laptop was clearly used to sabotage the demonstration.
